title: View learner progress and reports
content:
For centre staff using the student dashboard.
1. Open the relevant learner’s dashboard.
2. Select Report Card to open the report area.
3. Review report history and the relevant activity/date. This area also supports evaluation-linked reports and shared parent-facing reading reports.
Expected result: you can identify the intended report. Are you using the centre dashboard or a parent view? Do not send learner names or report contents in WhatsApp.
